name: Imagined Wind
body:
Imagined Wind

School illusion [air, phantasm)]; Level bard 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a fan)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (see text)
Saving Throw Will disbelieves (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the subject to believe it is battered by a terrific wind, coming from a direction of your choice. Treat this as a windstorm-strength wind, with the following exceptions.

If small enough to be checked by the wind, the target must make a Strength or Fly check at the beginning of each turn. On a failure by 5 or more, the creature staggers 5 feet backward and must make a Reflex saving throw or fall prone. A successful check allows the target to move against the wind at half speed, while a success by 5 or more allows it to move at full speed.

To the creature’s senses, the wind has all the expected effects on its surroundings. This can create additional effects; for example, if cast in a dusty environment, it might cause the creature to perceive a cloud of dust that grants concealment.

Effects and abilities that modify the impact of wind or weather apply as normal.

A successful Will saving throw allows the target to disbelieve the illusion.
